rv.q: It’s wholesome charm and energizing dance sitting on a bed of new-year-new-me platitudes best served on a For You Page.
Cost n’ Mayor bring their signature dance style and energy to the Orpheum Theatre, but the concept of their show struggles to hit the emotional beats.
It's a reminder that creativity is daring and that dance is uplifting: the show is a wonderful escape from the climate of despair that surrounds us today.
But if you want a complete storyline and depth–even an opportunity to connect with these characters to which the dancers give face, you may leave Orpheum Theatre feeling very underwhelmed.

cn.t: Critics praise this high-energy dance show from viral duo Cost n' Mayor for its upbeat, funky choreography and festive New Year's Eve atmosphere, finding it a nostalgic crowd-pleaser that successfully translates social media sensations to the stage.

vr.q: It was everything I wanted from a costen mayor off broadway show. Like, I. I left feeling so satisfied... This is your sign. You need to come to new york city.
On the positive side, there's a lot. The choreography is the real star here.
And while I don't think this show is saying or doing anything particularly groundbreaking, it is just a really fun time.
